name: open-superwhisper
description: Personal Mac dictation with Studio Qwen + E4B and local Qwen + S1 fallback

scripts.pack: npm run compile:native && npm run build:renderer && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.local.json --mac --arm64 --dir
scripts.build:mac: npm run compile:native && npm run build:renderer && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.local.json --mac --arm64
scripts.lint: eslint --config eslint.local.config.mjs desktop local-ui scripts/build-local-native.js scripts/dev-local.js test/local
scripts.format:check: prettier --check desktop local-ui scripts/build-local-native.js scripts/dev-local.js test/local vite.local.config.mjs tsconfig.local.json electron-builder.local.json package.json
scripts.quality-check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
scripts.test:python: uv run --no-project --python 3.13 python -m unittest discover -s local-runtime -p "test_*.py"
scripts.lint:python: uvx ruff check local-runtime scripts/setup-local-runtime.py && uvx ruff format --check local-runtime scripts/setup-local-runtime.py
